definitions.explanation: Food given to farm animals and livestock, including both natural and processed feed.

{飼料|しりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。

⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧{飼料|しりょう}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{依存|いぞん}→依存：11441_izon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{国産|こくさん}→国産：12017_kokusan⟧{飼料|しりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Efforts are underway to increase domestic feed production in order to reduce dependence on imported feed.

notes:
A compound of {飼|し} (to raise animals, to feed) and ⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧ (material, ingredient). The standard formal term for animal feed used in agriculture, news, and economics.

USAGE:
A homophone of ⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧ (materials, documents) — context usually makes the meaning clear. {飼料|しりょう} appears frequently in news about agriculture, food prices, and trade, since Japan imports much of its livestock feed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{配合|はいごう}→配合：16196_haigou⟧{飼料|しりょう} — compound/mixed feed
- {飼料|しりょう}{米|まい} — feed rice (rice grown for animal feed)
- {飼料|しりょう}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ — for feed use
- {飼料|しりょう}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧ — feed prices

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{餌|えさ}→餌：01886_esa⟧ — food for animals; general term, also used for pets and bait
- ⟦{肥料|ひりょう}→肥料：06102_hiryou⟧ — fertilizer; for plants, not animals
- ⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧ — materials, documents; homophone with different meaning
